rows.en:
(Today I'm gonna enjoy lunch
with Michel at Nyan-Nyan.)

Nyan-Nyan's always packed, though.
What do you think makes it so popular?

You can't even figure out
something that simple, \p?
What, you know why, Michel?

Of course I do.
Listen...

Cute girls like Ranka-chan and Nanase
are walking around in China dresses...
Any normal guy would come to look, right?
rows.notes: x2, Michel, both genders. China dress as earlier slices; Ranka-chan / bare Nanase as in the Japanese.

rows.en: S-so it's not because the food's good...

Well, to pull in this many customers,
good food is a basic requirement, sure.
Sorry to keep you waiting.
rows.notes: x4, Nyan-Nyan clerk serving the food.

rows.en:
Oh, looks like our food's here.
Let's eat while it's hot.

(Having lunch while chatting and having fun
with Michel like this isn't bad at all.)

(Today I'm going to enjoy lunch
with Michel-kun at Nyan-Nyan.)

Nyan-Nyan's always packed, though.
I wonder what makes it so popular?
What, you know why, Michel-kun?
Yeah, let's do that.
rows.notes: x3, female player agreeing to eat.

rows.en:
(Having lunch while chatting and having fun
with Michel-kun like this isn't bad at all.)
Anyway, Nyan-Nyan's packed again today, huh.

I told you before, didn't I?
Everyone's here for the China dresses.

Well, I don't think you should
just assume that...
Of course that's why.

(In Michel's head,
Nyan-Nyan = China dresses...?)

Anyway, Nyan-Nyan's packed again today,
isn't it?

(In Michel-kun's head,
Nyan-Nyan = China dresses...?)

(I came to the Observation Pier, but there's
nothing much to do. Maybe I'll head home soon...)
rows.notes: x4, both genders, frd_mcl_114. Observation Pier (glossary).

rows.en:
(Wait, huh? It's Michel.
What's he doing here?)

rows.notes: x4, Michel counting stars; numbers kept as written.

rows.en:
Michel, what are you doing,
counting like that?
Counting stars.
Counting stars...?

Sigh... And I was so close
to ten thousand, too......
rows.notes: x4, Michel; the player's call made him lose count.

rows.en:
What?! Were you really counting the stars?
They're so tiny... And ten thousand of them!

I've got good eyes.
This much is a piece of cake.
Wow~, that's amazing, Michel.

Aw, don't flatter me.
So what are you doing in a place like this?
I was just taking a walk.

I see. Then you're free, right?
Wanna go get some tea somewhere?

(Still, counting stars...
Michel, just how good are your eyes......)

(Wait, huh? Isn't that Michel-kun?
I wonder what he's doing here.)

Michel-kun, what are you doing,
counting like that?

What?! Were you really counting the stars?
They're so tiny... And ten thousand of them!
Wow~, that's amazing, Michel-kun.
I was just taking a walk.

(Still, counting stars...
Michel-kun, just how good are your eyes......)

(All right! Today I'm gonna do some
self-training to improve my skills!)

Hm? If it isn't \p.
Did you come to train too?

You said 'too'...
So you're here to train too, Michel?
rows.notes: Male. The Japanese stresses 'mo' (too) in quotes.

rows.en:
Yeah, there's something about my acrobatics
that's been bugging me.

(He's got talent, and he never slacks on effort.
So that's why he's No. 1 in our year...)
rows.notes: Male. gakunen nanbaa wan = top of the year.

rows.en:
There's only so much I can do training alone,
so this works out great.

Yeah, you're right.
Training together's probably more efficient.
I'm counting on you, Michel.
rows.notes: Male. yoroshiku tanomu yo: the player asks Michel.

rows.en: All right, first......
Well, that'll do for today.

Phew~, after all that, you're not even out
of breath. You really are amazing, Michel...

Your moves weren't half bad either.
If I'm not careful, you might even
overtake me...
rows.notes: x4, Michel to the player; the player answers 'What?'.

rows.en:
Come on, let's call it a day and head home.
See you.
Yeah, see you.
rows.notes: Male. Same English as the finished c02019.

rows.en:
(All right, even Michel praised me.
I'll keep working hard to hone my skills!)

(All right! Today I'm going to do some
self-training to improve my skills!)

You said 'too'...
So you're here to train too, Michel-kun?

(He's got talent, and he never slacks on effort.
So that's why he's No. 1 in our year...)

Yeah, that's true.
Training together's probably more efficient.
I'm counting on you, Michel-kun.
All right, first...
rows.notes: x3, Michel, both genders (variant of c10451).

rows.en:
Phew~, after all that, you're not even out
of breath. You really are amazing, Michel-kun...

(All right, even Michel-kun praised me.
I'll keep working hard to hone my skills!)
